description: Headball MVP — Heads Up-style ทายชื่อนักฟุตบอลบนหัว multiplayer game. Mobile-first Next.js 16 + Supabase realtime. See docs/PLAN.md for full plan and docs/DESIGN.md for Stadium Energy design system.

userStories.title: Add 0001_init.sql migration with all tables, enums, and RLS policies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database schema in place so all subsequent features have a place to read and write data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql exactly matching the schema in docs/PLAN.md (rooms, players, round_state, round_positions, round_events, football_players)
Include room_status and event_type enums
Include RLS policies: anon role can SELECT all tables; INSERT/UPDATE only via Postgres functions (no direct table writes from client)
Run `bunx supabase db reset` (or equivalent) successfully against local Supabase
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: 0001_init.sql: 6 tables, 2 enums, RLS SELECT-only for anon, realtime publication on rooms/players/round_state/round_events. Functions deferred to US-002.

userStories.title: Add submit_guess Postgres function and create_room/join_room helper functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need atomic write operations exposed as Postgres functions so the client never races on guess position counters.
acceptanceCriteria: Add submit_guess function exactly as specified in docs/PLAN.md (FOR UPDATE lock, atomic position increment, score calc, FOUL on miss)
Add create_room(p_max_rounds int, p_score_positions int, p_host_name text, p_host_player_id uuid) returning room code + player_id
Add join_room(p_code char, p_player_id uuid, p_display_name varchar) with checks: room exists, status=LOBBY, player count < 8, name length 1-20
Add start_round(p_room_id uuid, p_host_player_id uuid) that picks random distinct names from football_players for category and writes round_state rows + round_positions
Function security: SECURITY DEFINER with revoke-public + grant-anon
Migrations apply cleanly via `bunx supabase db reset`
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: 0002_functions.sql: SECURITY DEFINER fns create_room/join_room/start_round/submit_guess. anon-only EXECUTE; #variable_conflict use_column on join_room/create_room because returns table cols (room_id/player_id) shadow table cols. submit_guess returns table uses quoted "position" — reserved keyword. Seed migration must use 0003_*.sql now.
